tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// ldan yul du skyes pa ston pa brtson 'grus kyi dris lan bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dris pa'i lan cung zad gdab par bya ste/ de la gang zag gcig gi rgyud la sdom pa gsum dang ldan pas/ nang 'gal bar snang ba byung na/ dgag bya dang*/ dgos pa bltas la/ gang dgag bya shas che ba de mi spyad par/ dgos pa shas che ba de spyad par bya/ dgag dgos cha mnyam na/ 'og ma 'og ma btang snyoms su bzhag cing*/ gong ma gong ma gtso bor spyad de/ spyod 'jug las/ chung ngu'i don du che mi gtang*// zhes pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin la sogs// gang nas gong du khyad zhugs spyad// ces pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis// gong ma gong ma rnams kyis gnod// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// dri ba gnyis pa'i lan la/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam la bskal pa grangs med pa 'das kyang*/ sangs rgyas pa'i lam gyi grogs su mi 'gyur te/ byams pa'i zhal nas/ mdo sde rgyan las/ ma tshang ba dang 'gal ba dang*// thabs min de ltar ma bstan phyir// nyan thos kyi ni theg pa de// theg chen chos zhes bya ba min// zhes pa dang*/ rgyud sde dag las/ dmyal bar 'gro ba byang chub kyi// gtan gyi gegs byed ma yin te// nyan thos dang ni rang sangs rgyas// byang chub kyi ni gtan gyi gegs// zhes bya ba gsungs pa'i phyir// 'on kyang nyan rang gi lam la 'bad pas/ nyan rang gi 'bras bu grub pa'i mthar/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rjes bskul te/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ sangs rgyas par gsungs pa ni/ nges pa'i don yin te/ dam pa'i chos padma dkar po dang*/ lang kar gshegs pa dang*/ dpal phreng seng ge sgra'i mdo la sogs pa las rgya cher shes par bya'o// dri ba gsum pa'i lan la/ so sor thar pa'i rigs bdun gyi dbye ba ni/ dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ dge slong gsum la/ skyes pa dang*/ bud med kyi rten gyi dbye bas phye ba drug dang*/

bud med kyi phyogs la/ dge tshul ma dang*/ dge slong ma'i bar dang*/ bar slob la lo gsum slob dgos la/ skyes pa'i phyogs la/ de'i dod mi dgos pas/ de ltar na rigs dang gang zag gi dbye bas bdun du 'gyur ro// dri ba bzhi pa'i lan/ pha rol du phyin pa'i lam gyis sa lam thob pas/ gsang sngags nas bshad pa'i nang gi rtags thams cad nang du shugs kyis 'byung zhing*/ gsang sngags kyi brten 'brel gyi sa lam thob pa la'ang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa nas bshad pa'i phyi'i rtags rnams rim pas 'byung ba yin te/ sgrub byed kyi thabs kyi khyad ma gtogs pa bsgrub bya'i 'bras bu la khyad par med pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang thams cad la khyad med pa ma yin te/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs la sa bcu gnyis pa phyin chad kyi sgrub byed kyi thabs ma gsungs pas 'bras bu'ang med la/ gsang sngags la ni thabs dang 'bras bu gnyis ka gsungs so// dri ba lnga pa'i lan/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams la/ zab mi zab kyi khyad med kyang*/ bsgrub thag ring thung byung ba ni/ sngon gyi las 'phro yod med kyi dbang gis 'byung ba yin/ dri ba drug pa la/ thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'ang*/ las 'phro'i khyad par yod mod/ 'on kyang rje btsun ma sgrol ma bsgrub thag nye ba yin zhes/ rgya gar dang bod kyi chen po rnams zhal mthun par gsungs par 'dug dri ba bdun pa la/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i thabs kyi mthar thug gi 'bras bu grub pa'i dus nam yin zer ba ni/ spyir rnal 'byor bla na med pa la ye ma brten pa'i rgyud sde 'og ma rkyang pas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob mi srid de/ brtag gnyis las/ thams cad rig byed grub mtha' dang*// de bzhin las rgyas la sogs pas// srid pa dag 'gyur dngos grub min// yang ni srid mthar skye bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

las rgyas ni/ phrin las rgyas pa gtsor ston pa/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud man chad la zer ba yin/ 'og ma 'og ma la goms pas/ gong ma gong ma'i snod du gyur nas/ ring por mi thogs par rnal 'byor chen po nyid kyis/ sangs rgyas pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byed la 'bras bu nam 'grub kyi dus kyi dbye ba ma gsungs/ des na snga phyi yod kyang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags bla med ltar khyad par chen po med do// 'dir smras pa/ so sor thar pas lus ngag gi /nyes pa'i chu lon nyid byas te// byang chub sems la gzhi byas nas// rig 'dzin snying po'i tshul du spyad// gang zag cig gi nad rigs la'ang*// sman dpyad 'gal bar snang ba ltar// theg pa'i rim pa'ang gnas skabs kyis// byed pas 'gal ba ltar snang yang*// gnas skabs dbye ba shes pa yis// rnal 'byor pa la 'gal ba med// nang dang phyi yi dgag dgos dang*// sbyar nas spyod pa mkhas pa yin// sdom pa phra mo'ang gces par bsrung*// bdag pas gzhan gces blo dang ni// bla ma dang ni dkon mchog gsum// rang dang gnyis su med mthong ba// de tshe sngags dang phar phyin gyi// sdom dang dam tshig lhun grub yin// de ltar khyod kyis shes byas la// sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin bsrung*// ring por mi thogs rgyal ba yi// ye shes rgya mtshor 'jug par 'gyur// ldan gyi yul du skyes pa'i ston pa brtson 'grus zhes byas bas dris pa'i lan/ 'phags pa'i shing mo phag gi lo/ gdu bu'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu lnga'i nyin par gdams pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
